doc.title: Tony Parenti and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-06-29

title: Outstanding New Orleans trumpet players; Manuel Perez
summary: Parenti picks trumpeters he admired, such as Guarente, Christian and Perez, and discusses the Brunies brothers and Abbie.
